The '''Tshindral system''', also known as the '''Starlyte Station system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It was close to the edge of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and located on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]].<ref name="TEA" /> The system contained the planetoid [[Tshindral III]] which was orbited by [[Starlyte Station]].
